thread:
sahil: thinking of provisioning a new GPU node pool in europe-south2 (mediterranean region) to absorb low-latency customer traffic and reduce cross-region egress. proposing heterogeneous mix: 8 x A10G (price-sensitive) + 8 x A100-40GB (latency-sensitive). need advice on quotas, autoscaler settings, and eviction strategy.

marta: +1 on region, we've seen lower p99 from customers there. question: are these going to be preemptible/spot? that changes autoscaler behavior a lot.

sahil: plan is spot for A10G (cheap) and ondemand for A100. want a graceful fallback so latency-critical traffic can spill to A100 when A10G preempt.

dena: recommend taints and podTolerations per workload class. e.g. taint gpu=ondemand:NoSchedule on A100 nodes and toleration for latency pods. cheap jobs go to spot tainted nodes normally.

sahil: yep thinking: two pools -> gpu-spot-eus2 (A10G, taint=spot=true:NoSchedule, preemptible) and gpu-ond-eus2 (A100, taint=ondemand=true:NoSchedule). router policy to prefer ondemand for <100ms p99 routes.

bao: watch out for nodeboot times and image pull concurrency for A100s, they take longer. autoscaler flags we tuned before: --max-node-provision-time=15m, --scale-down-unneeded-time=12m, --expander=least-waste. may want --avoid-repeated-eviction.

sahil: good call. also need to coordinate quota request with cloud: GPU quota and regional vCPU quota for node VMs. i've prepared numbers in spreadsheet: initial: A10G x8 = 256 vCPU, A100 x8 = 512 vCPU (estimated). can someone sanity check?

marta: numbers look high, check machine type vCPU mapping. A10G flavor we use is n1-standard-32? that would be 32 vCPU each x8 = 256 yes. A100 is n1-highmem-64? verify exact SKU. also check local SSD / ephemeral disk quota.

dena: also add IPs and NAT egress capacity. For europe-south2 our NAT gateway has a small burst limit; we might need additional egress IPs or a small NAT pool for this nodepool to avoid throttling container image pulls during scale-up.

sahil: noted. i'll file a support ticket for additional NAT IPs and request GPU quota.

leo: small nit: make sure RBAC and KMS key access are configured for the Private models team if they'll run on ondemand A100s. we had an incident where a pod couldn't fetch keys after moving zones.

bao: on eviction strategy: use mixedScaling with nodeSelector and pod priority class. For spot nodes, set MaxEvictionsPerNodeGroup=1 in our controller to avoid mass churn. Also set deprovisioning delay for pods with local ephemeral caches.

sahil: draft nodepool terraform snippet:```resource "google_container_node_pool" "gpu_spot_eus2" {
  cluster = var.cluster
  node_count = 0
  management { auto_repair = true }
  node_config {
    machine_type = "n1-standard-32"
    accelerators { type = "A10G" count = 1 }
    preemptible = true
    taint { key = "spot" value = "true" effect = "NO_SCHEDULE" }
  }
  autoscaling { min_node_count = 0 max_node_count = 16 }
}```

marta: looks good, add labels for billing: "cost-center" and "workload-class" so Optimize can match costs per product.

sahil: will add. question: autoscaler surge settings? do we want buffer nodes (warm nodes) to avoid cold start p99 spikes?

dena: yes add a small warm pool: keep min=2 ondemand A100 nodes always up in gpu-ond-eus2. that reduces cold p99 but costs baseline. maybe 2 ondemand A100s.

sahil: agree. final checklist before I open quota ticket and terraform PR: 1) confirm exact machine SKUs and vCPU totals (marta) 2) NAT egress IP request (dena) 3) KMS/RBAC owners list (leo) 4) cost estimate + spot fallback policy (bao/marta) 5) labels and taints in TF (sahil)

bao: i'll run a quick cost sim later today and post numbers. if spot reclaim rate > 7% we should tilt towards smaller instance granularity for spots.

marta: i'll validate SKUs and update the spreadsheet.

dena: i'll open NAT ticket and look at pushing a pre-pull DaemonSet for heavy images to warm cache on warm nodes. reduces scale-up image pull egress.

infra-bot: terraform plan for branch feat/gpu-eus2 created: https://ci.redwood/infracloud/1234 (plan pending approvals) :rocket:

sahil: thanks all — i'll draft the quota/support ticket and tag folks. will follow up with PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
